change_scope: Append helper inside the vendor branch after all 213 Live checks, the ready property and SELECTED_READY; no RC, native, GKI or module ordering changes.
readiness: nonempty readable target MDT and DTB MDT in existing stock firmware directories
identity: canonical class link to pinned platform address
action: One standard state=start write per offline ADSP/CDSP. State is checked again inside the 20-second timed child. No other remoteproc target, SSR or retry.
outer_deadline_limit: The supervisor checks at most 45 one-second intervals, then signals direct workers without waiting. Scheduling overhead is additional. An uninterruptible kernel write can remain pending until kernel completion. The selected-module ready property was already published; no full-boot or DSP success is claimed.
state_race_limit: State read and start are not atomic. The rproc mutex prevents duplicate hardware boot, but a competing start can add a power reference. One attempt only, with no compensating stop.
runtime_observation: R54 firmware_mounts_complete at 6.093 s is later than audio module init at 5.635 s. Live modules do not imply firmware readiness. Early R55 auto-start failure is a source/timing prediction, not an observed R55 boot.
route_reason: Use standard remoteproc state directly. The adsp-loader boot path needs absent qcom,adsp-state and only covers ADSP; it is not appropriate for CDSP.
diagnostics: printf inherits the unchanged vendor.modprobe stdio_to_kmsg service directive in R54 /r32/overrides.rc. R54 dmesg contains the existing loader markers.
